your_book:
Thursday's session left Jaleel's book modestly mixed, with the overall portfolio sitting at a –2.98% unrealized loss. The standout movers were on opposite ends of the quality spectrum: Expand Energy (EXE, ~4% weight) led the book with a +2.22% day, while On Holding (ONON, ~4.4%) added +1.99% and NVIDIA (NVDA, ~12.3%) ticked up +1.09% — the latter helped by headlines tying it to SoftBank's $20B final investment round in OpenAI. The drag came from Danaher (DHR), which fell –4.42% on the day despite sitting on a +17.9% unrealized gain, and AstraZeneca (AZN, –2.33%) and Abbott (ABT, –2.17%), both carrying elevated risk flags, both sliding on a day when healthcare broadly softened.

The drift story is clearest in Zoetis (ZTS) and Boston Scientific (BSX) — both carry STRONG BUY verdicts and top-tier QARP scores (77.9 and 80.7 respectively), yet both sit in double-digit unrealized losses (–12.3% and –11.8%) and gave back ground again today. BSX has an earnings date on October 28 with a guidance-slash flag already on the books; price and thesis are pulling apart. Lululemon (LULU) remains the starkest divergence in the book: a –25.0% unrealized loss against a STRONG BUY verdict, with the next data point not until December 9. RKLB (Rocket Lab, ~7.3% weight, –10.1% unrealized) draws a hard AVOID verdict — a meaningful position that has no fundamental support from the scoring model.

Watch ABT into its October 21 print — the EPS-guide trim and today's –2.17% move together warrant attention. And keep an eye on Broadcom (AVGO, –2.15% today): headlines suggest the market is re-reading what the AI semiconductor trade actually means post-Micron, and AVGO sits in the book at an –8.9% unrealized loss.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated position at 7.3% weight — no model support
attention.note: Rocket Lab carries the book's only AVOID verdict and lowest QARP score (37.9), yet it is the fifth-largest position by weight; the absence of any thesis alignment makes continued sizing here a direct contradiction of the capital-preservation mandate.

attention.headline: Guidance-slashed, losing ground, earnings October 28
attention.note: Boston Scientific has had FY26 growth cut to 7–8.5%, management guided flat through Q3, the stock is down –11.8% unrealized, and gave back another –0.96% today — with a print in 27 days, the risk/reward on the current weight needs an explicit decision before October 28.

attention.headline: Danaher dropped –4.42% today on no flagged catalyst
attention.note: DHR is the book's single sharpest single-day loser on Thursday, yet carries no active risk flag and a HOLD-QUAL verdict with a +17.9% unrealized gain — worth identifying the driver before the cushion erodes further.

attention.headline: –2.17% today with EPS-guide trim flag, earnings October 21
attention.note: Abbott's FY EPS guide has already been cut and the stock fell –2.17% Thursday; with the next print on October 21, the book needs a clear view on whether to reduce ahead of potential further downside guidance or hold through.
